Website Broken, Hacked, or Showing Errors?

Website Repair Service — Get Your Website Fixed Fast

Broken Website or Losing Search Visibility? We Diagnose & Fix Critical Issues in Hours, Not Weeks.

From fatal PHP crashes and broken checkout flows to malware infections and critical website errors, our senior engineers quickly find the root cause, protect your data, and restore your site before you lose more customers.

  • Custom Websites
Fix My Website Now
Call (832) 266-7209

5.0 rating · U.S.-Based Support • Nationwide Website, SEO & AI Search Expertise
 Rated 5 out of 5

Common Website Problems We Fix Every Day

Pick the symptom you’re seeing. Every repair starts with a free diagnosis.

Fatal PHP Errors & White Screen of Death

“There has been a critical error on this website,” memory limit exhausted, or a plugin conflict after an auto-update.

Avg. turnaround: 1–2 hours

Hacked Website & Malicious Redirects

Spam or gambling redirects, Google “Deceptive Site Ahead” warnings, and injected backdoor PHP files.

Avg. turnaround: 2–4 hours

Database, SSL & Server Errors

Website issues—like HTTPS warnings, database failures, server timeouts, and hosting limits—stem from certificate expiration, server glitches, or misconfigured resources.

Same-day repair

Broken Checkout, Form Failures & Slow Loading

WooCommerce/Shopify cart errors, Stripe/PayPal webhook failures, missed lead forms. Mobile layout issues.

Same-day repair

Don’t see your issue? Get a free diagnosis·View pricing

Choose the Website Repair Service You Need

Tell us what’s wrong and we’ll route you to the right senior engineer, from emergency crash repair and hacked-site cleanup to SEO recovery, Core Web Vitals and ongoing maintenance for WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and custom sites.

Call Now: (832) 266-7209

Get a Free Ranking Audit

Text Us for a Speed Check

“Keep my website fast, secure, and issue-free.”

  • Ongoing monthly plans
Get a Care Plan Quote

Prefer to talk it through? Callortext us at (832) 266-7209 for a free diagnosis. No fix, no fee.

SEO, AEO & AI Search Repair

We Can Help Fix What’s Hurting Your Visibility on Google, ChatGPT & Gemini

We identify and fix the technical SEO, indexing, content and AI-search issues that can limit your visibility across Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI-powered search tools.

That includes investigating ranking drops, crawl and indexing problems, thin or outdated content, missing schema, pages that don’t match what people are searching for, and anything else that keeps search engines and AI systems from understanding and trusting your site.

Transparent Pricing & Expert Website Repair Services

  1. Single Critical Fix ($50 – $250): Fast emergency website repair for common errors like “Not Secure” SSL warnings, database connection failures, and 500/502/504 server timeouts. Includes a 15-minute engineer response, full pre-fix backup, root-cause troubleshooting, and a 14-day warranty. No payment required upfront.
  2. Complex Infection & Malware Reconstruction ($250 – $500): Full security recovery for hacked WordPress sites, severe malware infections, and corrupted databases. Includes deep database restoration, server-level disinfection, core file reconstruction, and Google Search Console blacklist removal. Zero advance payment.

 

Zero-Risk, Pay-After-Fix Guarantee: We never charge upfront. If your website issue cannot be resolved due to unrecoverable host-level data loss, you owe nothing.

Get a Free Error & SEO Audit

Years of Experience

How We Fix

Six Problem Areas We Repair

Most problems have more than one possible cause. We find the actual cause first, then fix it, so the same error doesn’t come back next week.

Website Downtime

A website that is inaccessible can immediately affect customer trust, online visibility, and sales opportunities. We quickly identify hosting, server, DNS, or configuration issues to restore access.

Hacked Websites & Malware Infections

Cyberattacks can damage your reputation, expose customer information, and trigger Google security warnings. We remove malware, repair damage, strengthen security, and help restore trust.

WordPress Errors

Plugin conflicts, theme issues, update failures, database corruption, and white-screen errors can break functionality. Our specialists restore websites safely while protecting your data.

Technical SEO Problems

Indexing issues, crawl errors, broken redirects, duplicate content, schema errors, and site structure problems can cause ranking losses. We identify and repair the issues affecting visibility.

Slow Website Performance

Page speed directly impacts user experience, conversions, rankings, and AI search visibility. We improve website performance, optimize Core Web Vitals, and enhance loading speed across devices.

Migration & Hosting Problems

A move to a new host or domain can break links, drop pages from Google and stop email or forms from working. We map old URLs to new ones, check DNS and email records, and test forms before and after the move.

COMMON WEBSITE REPAIR QUESTIONS

Need Help With One of These Website Problems?

Business owners often contact us when their website suddenly stops working, WordPress shows a critical error, or a website has been hacked. If you are experiencing one of these problems, our team can diagnose the cause and help get your website working again.

My Website Is Broken or Showing Errors — Who Can Fix It?

If your website is down, broken, showing errors, loading incorrectly, or important features have stopped working, we can diagnose the problem and repair the affected website functionality. Common issues: Website down • 500 errors • Broken pages • Hosting problems • Form errors • Database problems

My WordPress Website Is Showing a Critical Error — Can You Fix It Fast?

WordPress critical errors can be caused by plugins, themes, PHP problems, failed updates, corrupted files, or database issues. We troubleshoot the underlying cause and restore your website as quickly as possible. Common issues: Critical error • White screen • Plugin conflicts • PHP errors • Failed updates • WordPress login problems

My Website Was Hacked — Can You Remove the Malware and Secure It?

If your website has been hacked, infected with malware, redirecting visitors or showing security warnings, we find the infection, remove the malicious files and backdoors, repair what was damaged and secure the site against the same attack. Common issues: Malware • Redirect hacks • Backdoors • Spam pages • Security warnings • Unauthorized admin users

Expert Troubleshooting for Website, SEO & Performance Issues

A visible error is usually a symptom. We check each layer that could be causing it, so the repair addresses the root cause, not just the symptom:
  • WordPress core and PHP version
  • Plugins, themes and the database
  • Hosting, DNS and server settings
  • Custom code
  • Technical SEO and indexing
  • How search engines and AI tools read the site
Send us your website URL and describe what is happening. We will look into it, explain what we found and what the repair involves, and then fix it.

Why Choose Fix Website Issues by WevTEC

A quick patch can make an error disappear for a day. We take the slower first step of finding out why it happened, because that is what keeps it from coming back. We back up the site before making changes, avoid touching things that already work, and coordinate with your host or developer when the problem sits on their side. You get a plain explanation of what was wrong and what we changed.

Get Found in ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, and Gemini

🤖 ChatGPT✨ Google AI Overview💎 Gemini🔍 Bing

HOW CUSTOMERS SEARCH TODAY

Your Customers Search in More Than One Way

People no longer look for help in just one place. Whether they type a few keywords, ask a full question, or let an AI assistant find the answer for them, your website needs to be ready to show up.

Traditional Search

  • website repair service
  • WordPress repair
  • hacked website repair
  • technical SEO service
  • website malware removal

Conversational Search

  • "Who can fix my broken WordPress website today?"
  • "Why did my website stop appearing in Google?"
  • "Who can clean a hacked website?"
  • "Why did my website contact form stop working?"

AI-Assisted Search

  • "Find a website repair company that handles WordPress, security and SEO issues."
  • "Who offers pay-after-fix website troubleshooting?"
  • "Which company can repair my hacked website and correct SEO problems?"

Fix Website Issues prepares websites for both traditional search and modern AI-assisted discovery by improving crawlability, technical SEO, entity relationships, structured data, internal linking and direct-answer content.

How Our Website Repair Process Works

Our repair process is designed to be simple and transparent. First, tell us what is happening and send us your website URL. We review the issue, diagnose the likely root cause, and explain the recommended solution in clear language. Before significant changes, we create or verify a backup whenever appropriate. We then complete the agreed repair, test the affected functionality across the website, and confirm that the original issue has been resolved. Once the work is complete, we explain what was fixed and any steps that may help reduce the chance of the problem returning.
Request Free Website Audit

PAY AFTER FIX

Pay After Fix Website Repair

For qualifying standard website troubleshooting and repair projects, Fix Website Issues follows a pay-after-fix approach. Our team identifies the problem, completes the agreed repair and verifies that the affected website functionality is working before invoicing for the completed repair.

Eligibility may vary depending on project scope, third-party costs, development requirements and the type of repair required.

Request Website Repair

Nationwide Coverage

Website Repair for Businesses Across the United States

Fix Website Issues by WevTEC provides professional website repair and troubleshooting for businesses throughout the United States, with clients and service coverage across Texas, Florida, California, New York, Georgia, Illinois, Arizona, North Carolina, and other states nationwide. Because most website problems can be diagnosed and repaired remotely, our specialists can quickly assist businesses with WordPress errors, hacked websites, website downtime, slow performance, hosting issues, technical SEO problems, and other website failures—regardless of location.
Request Free Website Audit

Repair + AI Visibility

Website Repair Services We Handle

Website Repair & Recovery Services

If your website is down, hacked, slow, showing errors or losing rankings, we back it up first and then repair it. Our repair and recovery services include:

  • Emergency website error repair
  • WordPress website repair
  • Hacked website repair and malware removal
  • Broken layout repair
  • Technical SEO repair
  • Speed and Core Web Vitals optimization
  • DNS, hosting, SSL and database errors
  • Website migration support

AI Search Optimization

More customers now ask questions directly in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity and Bing Copilot before they ever click a website.

We make your site easier for these systems to read and trust, using:

  • Structured data
  • Clear answers to real customer questions
  • Entity and local business consistency
  • Author and business information that can be verified
  • Technical SEO and crawlability
  • An llms.txt file where it helps

No one can guarantee an AI tool will cite a business, but these fixes improve the chances. See AI Search Optimization for details.
